contact.basis: Dry Place d’Armes public pavement4.5m in front of facade center, outside church and raised entrance stair. Fixed before ground sampling and model geometry.

verticalDatum: Canadian Geodetic Vertical Datum2013(CGVD2013), NRCan HRDEM Mosaic DTM
attribution: Natural Resources Canada, HRDEM Mosaic, Open Government Licence – Canada
method: Original unmodified NRCan1m bare-earth DTM sampled bilinearly at pixel centres after WGS84 to EPSG:3979 projection in signed native basilica frame. Independent field frozen before model geometry,without flattening,building fitting or gap interpolation.
limitations: Ground beneath buildings is interpolated by source product.1m review grid is not a claim of survey accuracy.
Dry Place d’Armes pavement reference is host-relative CGVD2013 datum. Other host DEMs are not automatically compatible.
